segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, I rise today, I sit today to sponsor the proposed budget of the Department of Transportation for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Every day, millions of Filipinos spend hours in traffic, waiting in long lines at terminals,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: and endure uncertain commutes just to get to work, to school, or home to their families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Transportation is not merely about infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: It is about time, opportunity, and dignity of our people, for our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: This budget responds to that reality.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Through strategic investments in modern railways,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: safer roads, efficient airports, and stronger maritime facilities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: we are building a transport system that eases congestion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: improves safety, and connects communities across our archipelago,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: from the busiest urban centers to our most remote islands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: A reliable transport networks moves more

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: people and goods. It moves the economy forward. It opens markets for our farmers and fisherfolk, brings jobs closer to our workers, and ensures that no region is left behind in our pursuit of growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, supporting this budget therefore means supporting mobility, productivity, and inclusive development for every Filipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: It is an investment not only in steel, concrete, and runways, but in the future of our nation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan

segments.text: Ang problem pala po, Mr. Distinguished Colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: ang fuel subsidy, wala pong pondo and ang service contract program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yan po ang wala pong pondong na ibigay ang DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Pero may proposal po sana ang DOTR na 5B for fuel subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ang problema, 4B para po sa land-based.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang tinutukoy kanina, Distinguished Sponsor, ay subsidy para sa amortisisyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi ang issue nila, yung mga utang nila dahil sa modernisisyon natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, mayroon naman palang subsidy para sa amortisisyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang susunod ko pong katanungan, mayroon po tayong iba-ibang mode of transportation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pwede ko po bang matanong ang aking kaibigan na sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: ilan po ba talaga yung mode of transportation natin sa buong bansa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Land, air, marine, and rail po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, napapansin ko po, tuwing may mga crisis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: ang palagi lang nating nasusubsidize yung land, mga bus, jeepneys.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang issue na ito is reiteration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: doon sa special power ni Presidente to suspend excise tax noong nag-break tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, ngayon po ba sa 2027 na NEP ng DOTR, sinama na po ba yung other mode of transportation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Pinakamalaki pong nabadgetan po ngayon ang rail transport program po, RTP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Kala po ng mga 72.4% po under RTP, under OSEC po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: And ang second biggest is the maritime infrastructure program, mga 6.7%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: And the land public transportation program, 6.1%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yan po ay yung unang tatlong pinakamalaking pondo na ilaan para sa DOTR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Lumalabas po, 18,000, 18 million, 18,137 million for maritime infrastructure program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Puwede po bang malaman ano yung specific na inaalaw na paggagamitan ng pondong yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mayroon po sana nakalaan na 1 billion para sa maritime based program, service contract po, program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ang problema lang po, hindi po naisama sa NEP, pero yan po yung proposal ng DOTR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: During the budget legislation, hindi lang po naisama ng DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yung 1 billion out of the 5 billion para po sa service contracting

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: [unclear] ko po naitanong 'yan, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Alam naman po natin na ang Pilipinas ay napakaraming isla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kaya po, nagtataka ako bakit nakatotok lang tayo sa mga jeepney bus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung paabay tinotoka natin dahil nagra-rally sila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Dahil po ba yung mga pump boats,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: sa Siargao, sa Dinaga at sa Rumblon, doon sa Samar, ay walang subsidy yung mga pasahero doon

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: kahit nagmahal na yung pamasahe dahil sa fuel, dahil hindi sila nagra-rally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kung totoosin, pwede naman pong maglakad yung nasa lupa, pero kami po sa isla,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: hindi po namin pwedeng lakarin para makatawid kami sa kabila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kailangan namin sumakay. Dito pwedeng mag-bike, pwedeng mag-jogging.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Doon po, hindi po namin magagawa yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So bakit po, sa napakaraming taon na nagdaan, tuwing may crisis, jeep nilang, bus lang ang may subsidy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, tama po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mabuti lang po ang DOTR ay nakalaan po ng 200 million para po sa maritime programs for 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: And sa 2027, mayroong pong 1 billion na nakalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Kaya lang sa kasamang palad, hindi po naisama sa, ng DBM sa, during the budget legislation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kaya, kaya talagang sasamayin ang palad namin sa, sa taga-isla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So siguro mag-strike na lang din kami, taga-summer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi na magbibiyahi yung mga pampot sa Romblon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sana po, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: May I appeal to DOTR na kayo, kayo, kayo po kasi yung mandated, no, sa transportation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mandate po ninyo na equal, nasaan na po yung equal protection clause natin na pinili lang natin yung ibang sektor sa transportation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi naman po, po pwede, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, na ang sagot lang natin sa mga taga-isla,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: magtiis kayo kasi sa kasamaang palad, hindi naisama ng, ah, DBM yung, ah, subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung 200 million po, ah, I appreciate that, no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I can attest na nakarating din po sa dinagat yan sa Siargao, pero sampung araw lang po yung, ah, yung service contract.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: At least nabawasan ng 60 pesos yung, ah, pamasahe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero yung sampung araw, okay na rin ninyo, at least.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: No? Ah, hindi kami umabot sa rally na yung mga pambot mag-angkla doon sa, ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero sana, ah, maipare-consider ninyo, seriously, ah, lobby doon sa, sa DBM na maibalik yung, ah, 1 billion na subsidy para sa maritime.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi napaka-unfair po sa mga taga-isla na yung taga-mainland, since time immemorial,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: you enjoy every crisis, they, they always enjoy the subsidy, while yung mga nasa dagat, wala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ah, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, ang DOTR po ay nagpapasalamat kay Congressman Dagoog for spearheading the maritime, ah, transport program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Malaking bagay po ito na ma-i-sab, ma-i-dagdag, maka-i-dagdag po natin dito sa Kongreso ang nawala pong 1 billion para po sa maritime transport.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, for the record, no, I am very frustrated and dismayed to the Department of Budget and Management na hindi nila sinama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sana walang taga-DBM na nakatira sa isla o ipinanganak sa isla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kung mo ba nandito na sila nagtatrabaho sa Maynila, nakalimutan na nila na galing sila sa isla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasamahan ko dito sa Berm, Hulo, Sulo, Tawi-Tawi, Basilan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Bakit? Hindi ba mga Pilipino yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, medyo may problema tayo sa DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Nandito naman siguro yung DBM because normally, DBM is represented sa lahat ng budget deliberation sa lahat ng agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sana maiparating nyo kay Sekretary Kim na yung definition niya sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sa DBM, dapat ang budget daw ay makatao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi po makatao na ang isubsidize natin, land transportation lang, Sekretary Kim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mali po yung definition mo sa DBM na dapat budget makatao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi po makatao yung pinipili mo lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sana ma-restore mo yung subsidy sa isla para hindi mo malabag yung equal protection ng ating konstitusyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mga Pilipino din po kami na taga Hulo, Sulo, Dinagat, Rumblon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Samart, mga Pilipino din po kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, anyway, siguro malinaw yung naiparating natin sa DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi po ito kasalaanan ni DOTR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ganito kakapal yung question ko pero last question na lang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Doon sa ano natin, sa air transportation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: In one of the hearings, yata.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sa Committee on Transportation, nabanggit ninyo na hindi na sinisingil ni CAB at saka ni CAB yung mga fees and charges sa ating mga airlines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ang tinatanong po nyo is the fuel surcharge.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero may mga fees pa yata yun na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yes, may trigger mechanism po ang fuel surcharge kung nagkaroon po ng 20% increase dito po sa fuel prices, sa global fuel prices po bago po maka-charge po ng fuel surcharge.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, tinatanggal po siya, sinususpend pag maabot yung trigger?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Sir, nagkakaroon po ng instead na 30-day price interval, nagiging 15 days po. So, twice a month po yung pagsukat po ng increase ng fuel prices po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: But there's an automatic mechanism na pagka bumaba below 100 ang Jet A1 fuel na price, bumaba po ng $100 per barrel, babalik po sa dating 30-day interval.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, para lang may idea ang ating mga air passengers, magkano po ba yung fuel surcharge na yan doon sa ticket natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Is that regardless sa layo ng destination or per ticket?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Magkano po at the average yung fuel surcharge?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, mayroon po sinusunod ang DOTR na matrix pero medyo mahaba po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: But if the Distinguished Colleague will allow us to submit a written complete matrix po to your office and to this committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pinakamataas at saka pinakamababa na lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Nagre-range po ang domestic, Mr. Speaker and Distinguished Colleague, by domestic, nagre-range po between P457 to P1,336.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: For international, nagre-range po sa P1,509 to P11,220.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Okay, thank you, Distinguished Sponsor. At least may idea na ako.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, ang katanungan ko na lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tuwing isususpend yan, kung mag-trigger yun,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: papaano po may no-monitor ng CAB yung amount na yan na talagang nare-reflict na tatapyas doon sa binabayaran noong pasahero?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi baka nagsasayang tayo ng revenue ng gobyerno,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: pero hindi rin naman napakinabangan, hindi natin na siguro na nag-reflect siya doon sa cost ng ticket.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mayroon po bang pamamaraan ang Civil Aeronautics Board na na-monitor yan na talagang tinatanggal yung amount na yan sa mga airline?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yung Civil Aeronautics Board po, Mr. Speaker, dear Distinguished Colleague, mayroon pong price monitoring system po silang sinusunod para sa increase or decrease of the airfare prices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sigurado si CAB na yung tinapyas nila dahil sinuspend noong time na yan ang ating fuel surcharge ay nare-reflict naman talaga sa ticket.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yes. The airlines will submit written report po sa CAB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, maraming salamat po sa ating kaibigan, sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: At sa DOTR, maraming salamat at umaga na ba? Ah, wala pa. Hindi pa pala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, i-submit ko na lang itong ibang katanungan ko. Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Sergio [unclear] Dagooc, [unclear] APEC Party List. Majority Leader, please.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Percy Cendaña of Akbayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Party List to interpellate on the proposed budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: The Akbayan Party List, Representative Percy Cendaña, you are now recognized, sir. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Ginong Speaker, at magandang gabi po sa ating distinguished sponsors at sa buong DOTR family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Bilisan ko na po yung mga tanong para hindi po tayo umagahin. Una pong mga tanong tukol po sa right-of-way.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Magkano po ang current budget natin for the acquisition of right-of-way ng DOTR?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Dito po sa NEP, bagamat insufficient po ang pondo, is 2.7 billion po for the North-South Commuter Railway alone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, pag sinabi po natin insufficient, insufficient po by how much?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ang total na kailangan po for 2027 is 30 billion, Mr. Speaker, Ginong Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kung ito po ay para sa North-South Commuter Railway lamang, paano po ang ating Metro Manila Subway Project?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Kaya kulang rin po, distinguished colleague, kaya po humingi po ang DOTR ng karagdagang pondo for both North-South Commuter Railway and Metro Subway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kumusta naman po sa MRT-7? Meron po ba tayong right-of-way requirement po po dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: May issues pa rin po ba tayo ng right-of-way for MRT-7, distinguished colleague?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ah, wala na po, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, ang pinag-uusapan po natin dito ay ang right-of-way acquisition for both the Metro Manila Subway Project at ang North-South Commuter Railway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Given po na talagang malayo sa target amount natin, yung nag-reflect sa NEP, ano po ang implication nito in terms of our timelines?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Target completion dates, Mr. Speaker, ginoong sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Definitely, madi-delay po ang dalawang projects po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, may we know by how many months or years madi-delay ang dalawang proyektong ito dahil po sa kakulangan ng right-of-way acquisition allocation para po sa dalawang proyektong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Distinguished colleague, may karagdagang po ang dalawang taon na delay po ang magiging efekto po nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, ginoong speaker, talaga po nakababahala na dahil po sa kakulangan sa allocation for right-of-way acquisition,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: madi-delay po ng dalawang taon ang Metro Manila Subway Project at ang North-South Commuter Railway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sigurado po ako na sa pag-narinig ito ng ating mga kababayan sa Central Luzon, sa Metro Manila at sa Southern Tagalog,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: talaga pong umaaray sila para malaman na dalawang taon ang magiging delay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, given this two-year delay, kailan din?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kailan din po ang kumplisyon kung pag-uusapan po natin ang full operational mode ng dalawang proyektong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: So, kung matadagdagan po ng hinihinging pondo ng DOTR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: ay baka kaya pang mahabol sa same timeline po na nakaset, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero kung hindi po madadagdagan, kailan po? Ano pong taon ang pinag-uusapan natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ang estimate po ng DOTR, minimum of two years po ang may dadagdag, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, anong taon po itong sinasabi natin na minimum of two years?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: For the North-South Commuter Railway, from 2033 to 2035.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: For the Metro Subway, from 2031 to 2033, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nakalulungkot pong balita na kailangan pong maghirap, magtiis na ating mga kababayan ng dagdag pang dalawang taon

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: dahil sa kakulangan po ng allocation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Binanggit ko kanina, time, opportunity, and dignity of our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi ito naman po talaga yung sinachampion ng departamento when it comes to developments in our transportation infrastructure system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero meron na po kasi isang programa na gumagana at napapakinabangan ng milyong-milyong Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero nakapagtataka po kung bakit ang nasa NEP ay zero ang budget para sa programang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ito po ang EDSA Busway System.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kahapon lamang po, lumabas sa Manila Bulletin ang isang news article.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Palace backs EDSA Busway funding request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nagmula po mismo ang pahayag na ito sa Palace Press Officer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero alam naman po natin na hindi ito ang nakareflex NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Zero ang pondo ng EDSA Carousel for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sana po nag-uusap ang Palasyo at DBM

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Initial budget hearing pa lang po nangungulit na ang akbaya na magbibigyan ng pondo ang programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At hindi natin tatantanan ang issue ito para sa 60 million na mananakay sa ating pong EDSA Bus Carousel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Gusto lang po nating malaman, may update na po ba regarding the program's budget, Mr. Speaker Ginong Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, for mentioning the EDSA Carousel Busway Project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Sumulat po ang DOTR na maibalik po ang 1.7 billion na pondo dito po sa Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Sana po matulungan ng Distinguished Colleague na maibalik po ang naturang pondo po for the EDSA Carousel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi lamang po ang mga commuter ang nananawagan para dito, pati po ang malakanyang mismo nagsabing suportado nito ang pagpopondo sa EDSA Carousel for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sana po, Mr. Speaker, i-prioritize ng Committee on Appropriations sa period of amendments ng GAB,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Why would we cancel a program that works and serves the people?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, dear colleague, there are three classifications of the pathway, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Ang class 1 po, pag new pathway construction,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: the estimated cost is around 10 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Then, sa class 2, may, ano, may, with physical separators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: the cost will be more or less 5.4 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Then, for class 3, ayan yung tinatawag na pavement marking only.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, sa computation ko po, yung 498 kilometers reported for the Bayanihan II funding of 1.09 billion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So mukhang pintura lang po talaga to. Parang ganun. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Combination. Pero, well, it would seem that most of it ay yung type 3 na tinatawag ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, again, magkano po ang proposal? Napaka, mahirap naman po tanggapin na 5 kilometers lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And how much, ano po ang kung breakdown nitong 1.2 billion na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: For 1.2 billion, it's more or less 180 kilometers of new and maintained bike lanes and walkways.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Combination na po ito ng class 1, class 2, and class 3.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: So all three types. Ganun po. No?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Noted po. Pero malinaw po ang mandato dito sa special provision.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bike lanes should have smooth pavement, be free of hazards, and with durable physical separation from mixed traffic lanes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung sa class 1, class 2, class 3 na sinasabit nyo, kung pintura lang, does that count as durable physical separation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So malinaw po ang mandato dito. Type 1. Ano ba yung term? Class or type?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung pathway. Yung class 2, ano nga po yung class 2? May barrier.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Yung class 2, may carriageway siya pero may separator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bollard. Okay. Yung class 1, yung talagang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O bago. At saka, is it elevated? Ganun po ba? Hiwalay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. At paano po, hindi lang naman siklista, paano po yung sa pedestrians at saka PWD? Ano naman po ang gagawin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Para sa mga pedestrian at PWD?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Sa class 1 yan, dear colleague. Sidewalk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sidewalk. Okay. Sidewalks with PWD access. Yan lang po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Alright. Well, Mr. Speaker, needless to say, sinusuportahan po natin ang panukala para sa additional 1.2...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang nakalaan ngayon na proposal na

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: BARC and we will be supporting this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So hanggang doon na lang po, Mr. Speaker.
